scripts.install:backend: for svc in auth user inventory borrow audit; do cd services/$svc-service && composer install && cd ../..; done
scripts.migrate:all: for svc in auth user inventory borrow audit; do cd services/$svc-service && php artisan migrate:fresh --force && cd ../..; done
scripts.start:backend: npx concurrently "npm run gateway" "npm run serve:auth" "npm run serve:user" "npm run serve:inventory" "npm run serve:borrow" "npm run serve:audit"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
